package.description: Convert rich text on the clipboard to Markdown

en-US.description: Convert rich text on the clipboard to Markdown
en-US.longDescription:
md-paste reads HTML from the system clipboard, converts it to Markdown, and
writes it back. It ships a console CLI (md-paste.exe) and a system tray app
(md-paste-tray.exe) that converts the clipboard from the tray menu.
en-US.name: md-paste
